description: Defines a Flutter widget 'ProductDetailPage' that displays detailed information for a specific book, including image, title, author, rating, price, description, and an 'Add to Cart' button. It fetches book data asynchronously using a provider-based API.

classes.name: ProductDetailPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays detailed information about a book, identified via 'bookId', and allows adding the book to the cart.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _ProductDetailPageState.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI of the page based on the current state, displaying book details or loading/content placeholders.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads the book data asynchronously after the first frame.
